_comment: content10h design_systems (3 Nov 2026): the systems-angle design for docs/content-10h/designs/systems.md. Run it with the extended copy of the prototype (scratchpad c10/design-systems/content10h.py; the project's tools/sim/content10h.py is unchanged and ignores the copy's keys guests_per_tpm, in_rewards, offline_x2, tier_new, earn.all_dishes and ladder_limit). The overlay is the WHOLE plan (all phases): 8 highways, the Highway Hotel on each, Izzat, slot mastery, one festival in sessions mode. Phase 1 (pre-launch) = --set content.ladder_limit=4 --set content.hotel.enabled=false --set 'content.izzat.perks.warm_welcome.costs=[]' --set 'content.festivals=[]'. Phase 2 = ladder_limit 4 with the hotel. Money in ref units (x10 on screen). No economy number outside content is changed: the offline rule stays 1/4 of the takings for up to 2 h, x2 with the ad.

content._ladder_comment: Each move: prices x1.5 (location mult, measured from NH 44; x2 renovation on top). cost_mult = the highway's cost dial (every post-tutorial cost). Move cost = about 7 minutes of the takings when the move opens without the hotel (phase 1), about 4-7 with it. Move rule: all 16 dishes and the hotel done (hotel_done holds on a highway with no hotel). Hotel overrides: opening, room and tier costs x max(1, cost_mult / mult), rounded, so hotel costs follow the dhaba's cost dial and hotel rates follow its prices. Results: docs/content-10h/designs/systems.md.

hotel._comment: Highway Hotel (phase 2): opens when every counter is at L50 (12 dishes) in the family layout, so it runs beside the climb to L100. 2 rooms come with it, 8 in all; 5 room tiers (charpai, cot, fan, cooler, AC); the first room to reach a tier on a highway is NEW. A night's guests = 0.35 x the travellers a minute (signboard included), filling the best rooms first. Paid at dawn, once per 600 s day cycle of play. Done = 8 rooms at tier 5. Its income counts in every rate path: rewards (in_rewards) and the offline rule (1/4 for up to 2 h, x2 with the ad).

izzat._comment: Izzat: permanent, never reset by a move. Earned once per key (highway + milestone, dish slot + tier, weekend, festival). Perks never run out: Good name has 30 levels (cost +1 Izzat a level), the endless sink. No offline perk.

old_staff.name: Old staff: start each new dhaba with one more waiter

savings.name: Savings: start each new dhaba with 500 x its price multiplier a level

good_name.name: Good name: +3 % on every price a level (30 levels)

quick_hands.name: Quick hands: cooks 4 % faster a level

fast_feet.name: Fast feet: waiters 4 % faster a level

known_face.name: Known face: start each new highway with the signboard one level up

warm_welcome.name: Warm welcome: the hotel pays 8 % more a level (phase 2)

mastery._comment: Recipe stars: one track per counter menu slot (16), counted across highways (scope slot), so leaving a highway strands nothing. Stars at 100, 200, 400 ... 12,800 serves (x2), 8 per slot, 128 in all. Each star: +1 Izzat and +1.5 % on that slot's dish price; +1 % on the counter per set level (the lowest star count of its 4 slots).

festivals.name: festival week (phase 2-3; one of about 6 a year, placed on day 10 for the 15-day check)
